purpose: The one place in bench/ where a model is named. Every child of the embedder study reads a model from here; adding a model means adding a record. Enforced by bench/check_models.py.

states.available: listing read; at least one addressable ONNX file
states.confirmed_absent: listing read; no addressable ONNX file

dtype_addressing: A dtype is addressable when the repo publishes model<suffix>.onnx for the suffix DEFAULT_DTYPE_SUFFIX_MAPPING gives it (@huggingface/transformers 4.2.0, src/utils/dtypes.js). A repo can hold ONNX and address nothing: see multilingual-e5-small-intfloat.

probe.authentication: HF_TOKEN, from the environment or ~/.config/keys/huggingface.env. Without it every gated repo reads as could-not-look, which is how the tracker's first pass mistook a published mirror for a missing one.

field_notes.params: safetensors parameter total declared by the repo named in the source, null when none is declared
field_notes.dim: the width of the vector the model emits
field_notes.max_seq: see max_seq_source per record: a positional capacity and a truncation length are different numbers
field_notes.languages: the repo's own declared list; R7 is checked against it mechanically
field_notes.input_template: prefixes the driver applies. Empty strings mean none, which is a measured fact and not a default
field_notes.mrl: a vendor claim, recorded as a claim; no measurement here
field_notes.availability: observed, refreshed by the probe above; everything else is hand-maintained
